title: Great support from Michael!
body: I had an issue with my subscription, but the support team was amazing. Special thanks to Michael, who handled my case, fixed everything, and was very helpful throughout the process. Highly recommend!
author: Samir_Az

title: Scam!
body:
This is a scam. For several months now, $50 has been charged to my card every month, even though I unsubscribed a long time ago and deleted the app.
Scammers!!!
author: Prostoy Vetendash

title: They took my money for a subscription I didn't sign up for
body: Why did your app charge $94 from my card for no reason? I did not renew any subscription or anything like that. Please return my money. This charge doesn’t even appear in the App Store. You just took money from my card, there is no subscription there. This is fraud.

title: Недоработанное приложение
body:
в приложении стабильно даёт сбой функция сохранения. И так при постановке задачи на день и записи благодарности, на следующее утро это исчезает. Происходит как правило в субботу и в воскресенье.
Также переходя с субботы на воскресенье деактивируется функция перехода по дням.
Нет синхронизации с трекером сна, встроеном в айфон.
author: Cirtdan777

title: Failed their proposal
body: First of all, the programme is not personalized. It is totally AI based. Secondly, they promised that the program is free for some times and you have other bonuses to open different platforms. However, even each material costs money. It required 44 US after a week trial however this has never been communicated
